tei:div.tei:p: rnam dag gtsug gi nor bu la jo bos gnang ba'i blo sbyong lags so/ /shes bya'i mkha' la tshad yod ma mchis kyang / /stong dang snying rje gnyis su med pa yi/ /mar me mdzad pa la sogs bla ma la/ /sgo gsum dang ba'i yid kyi gus phyag 'tshal/ /'gro mgon bod du byon khar gdams pa ni/ /brtse bar gyur pa'i nor bu bdag la gnang / /nam mkha' 'di la rgyu rkyen ma mchis bu/ /yod par su 'dzin med par su zhig 'dzin/ /chos rnams de bzhin shes par gyis shig bu/ /'di la gol na gol sa shin tu mang / /nam mkha' lta bur mnyam par gzhog cig bu/ /'on kyang mkha' la 'ja' tshon 'khrigs pa na/ /yod yod lta bur mdzes shing 'char ro bu/ /'di la rgyu rkyen yod par sus ma mthong / /'on kyang rten 'brel lags mchis mkhas pa'i bu/ /'ja' tshon mkha' la rgyu zhing mkha' la yal/ /'di la rgyu rkyen yod par sus ma mthong / /'di yang rten 'brel lags mchis mkhas pa'i bu/ /legs par brtags na 'ja' tshon nam mkha' ru/ /tha dad rnam dbye 'dug gam mkhas pa'i bu/ /ye nas stong pa chos kyi gnas lugs la/ /'gro la bzod glags med pa'i snying rje 'khrigs/ /snying rje byung yang chos kyi dbyings nas byung / /thim yang chos kyi dbyings su thim mo bu/ /'khor 'das thams cad rang gi sems nyid de/ /de yang rgyu rkyen yod pa sus ma mthong / /brtags shing dpyad na nam mkha'i 'ja' bzhin gda'/ /des na nam mkha' 'ja' tshon ji lta bur/ /stong nyid snying rje shes par mdzod cig bu/ /gang yang rgya mtsho gting mtha' zab pa las/ /steng nas g.yo ba'i rba rlabs 'khrigs pa mthong / /rba rlabs byung yang rgya mtsho nyid las byung / thim yang rgya mtsho nyid las thim mo bu/ /g.yo ba'i rlabs dang zab pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /tha dad rnam dbye yod pa sus ma mthong / /de bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i stong nyid las/ /'gro la g.yo zhing 'khrigs pa'i snying rje byung /

/snying rje byung yang stong nyid ngang las byung / /thim yang stong pa nyid la thim mo bu/ /me long g.ya' yis dag pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /sna tshogs gzugs brnyan bkra bzhin shar ba de/ /me long nyid dam phyi rol gzugs las byung / /de las gzhan nam 'on te rgyu med pa/ /gang du'ang dpyad na 'jig rten rten 'brel tsam/ /byed bzhin yod ma myong dang snang ba gnyis/ /tha dad rnam dbye yod par sus ma mthong / /de bzhin stong nyid me long lta bu las/ /yod ma myong ste gzugs brnyan 'char ba ltar/ /stong dang snying rje bsten zhig mkhas pa'i bu/ /rnyog med chab kyi dkyil 'khor dwangs pa la/ /chu shel zla ba'i gzugs brnyan shar na'ang / /gnyis snang lta bur rang nyid 'khrul mod kyi/ /grub pa'i rnam dbye yod par sus ma mthong / /rnyog med nam mkha' lta bu'i stong nyid las/ /'gro la bzod glags med pa'i snying rje shar/ /snying rje byung yang stong nyid ngang las byung / /thim yang stong nyid ngang du thim mo bu/ /ji ltar gzugs kyi brag ri mthon po la/ /lhang lhang 'char ba'i sgra snyan byung na yang / /sgra snyan brag las rnam dbye su zhig yod/ /'on kyang grags mod yod med su zhig 'dzin/ /de bzhin ye nas dag pa'i stong nyid las/ /'gro la shin tu brtse ba'i sgra byung mod/ /stong nyid snying rje de bzhin bsgom shig bu/ /rnyog med nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dwangs pa la/ /'gro la dngos su phan pa'i 'od 'byung mod/ /nyi 'od tha dad nyid du sus ma mthong / /stong nying snying rje chen po gzugs su shar/ /snying rje de yang stong pa 'ba' zhig ste/ /stong pa nyid las snying rje gzhan yod par/ /mgon po gang gis ma bshad mkhas pa'i bu/ /kye ho stong nyid ngang du tshur nyon zhig /'gro ba thams cad nyon mongs sdug bsngal spangs/ /stong nyid 'ba' zhig yin gyi shes par mdzod/ /de'i gnyen po yon tan mtha' yas kyang / /stong nyid 'ba' zhig yin gyi goms par mdzod/

/spang gnyen tha dad lta bur mthong na yang / /'khrul 'khor dag par bsam gtan lam du bsgom/ /de ltar ma go 'gro ba mtha' yas pa/ /rang la bsdus kyang spang dgos cang gda' 'am/ /stong nyid snying rjer ltos dang cang 'khrul lam/ /snying rje stong par 'dug gam mkhas pa'i bu/ /stong pa snying rjer shar ram rtog dpyod can/ /stong dang snying rje rnam dbye 'dug gam a/ /kho bos zhe sdang rlung dmar 'tshubs na yang / /stong pa nyid las tha dad med par mthong / /de bzhin rnam par rtog pa mtha' yas pa/ /stong nyid ngang las nges par 'byung ba mthong / /rnam rtog rnams la cer te ltas tsa na/ /bden nam rdzun nam grub par ngas ma mthong / /stong nyid ngang las lhod kyi klod tsa na/ /rtog pa tsam yang 'char ba ngas ma mthong / /de na stong nyid snying rje 'gal zla yang / /dbye ba rdul tsam yod par ma mthong gi /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med smos ci 'tshal/ /kye ho da ni 'gro'am 'dug na yang / /gnas de dgon pa yin no mkhas pa'i bu/ /dbu ma'i nang du sems nyid gnas pa de/ /stong pa'i gnas lugs yin no mkhas pa'i bu/ /de yi ngang du snying rje bsgom pa de/ /dbye ba med pa'i rnal 'byor yin no bu/ /de ltar shes pa'i snying rje bsgom pa na/ /shin tu brtse yang stong nyid 'ba' zhig yin/ /stong nyid bsgom pas snying rjes ma khyab med/ /snying rje bsgom pa stong nyid kho na yin/ /stong pa tsam zhig zhi gnas 'tshol ba'ang bsgom/ /theg pa 'di yi stong nyid snying rje yin/ /snying rje 'di yi rang bzhin stong nyid yin/ /des na gnas don snying rjer shes par mdzod/ /khyod la bya ba'i rim pa mtha' yas kyang / /brgya phrag ngos kyi bcar phur chen po 'di/ /tshe 'di'i nyin bshad snying gtam tha mar bsten/ /da ni kho bo mi sdod bod du 'gro/ /'phreng sems dag kyang rdza dang la cha 'dra/ /tshe 'di'i 'du byed mi rtag glog ltar g.yo/ /lus sems 'du ba'ang mgron khang mgron po 'dra/

/des de phyogs 'dir sdod pa srid pa bas/ /'dus pa'i tha ma bral ba 'dus byas chos/ /gdams ngag sems la 'chang na bu yin a/ /bslab pa'i ngag la nyan na yun du dge /ring por mi thogs byams pa'i zhabs drung du/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i tshig don rnams/ /yongs su rdzogs par bya phyir dga' ldan 'gro/ /khyod kyang skye ba 'di'i 'og rol tu/ /de drung snyegs nas gsung gleng byed par smon/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus pa/ /bdag cag rnams la brtse bar dgongs su gsol/ /dus gsum 'khor tshe skye gnas thams cad du/ /sgo gsum dge ba'i las la bkol ba rnams/ /sku gsum phrin las rdzogs pa ma gyur bar/ /gang gi lus su skye ba 'dzin na'ang / /pha rol phyin bcu sgo gsum 'khor ba dang / /bla ma mnyes shing 'phrin las spel bar shog /ces pa 'di 'gro ba'i mgon po bod du byon dus lam du 'jug pa na/ rnam dag gtsug gi nor bu la spyi chos su gdams pa lags so/ /'di'i brgyud pa ni/ jo bo nas mkhan po rma ston gyi bar sngar bzhin/ des jo ldan klung shod pa la/ des bshes gnyen shes rab bzang po/ des bud+dhā rat+na la/ /des kīrti shī la la/ /des chos rje rgyal ba bzang po la/ /des chos rje bsod nams rin chen la/ des chos rje gzhon nu rgyal mchog la'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 jo bo rje/ rnam dag gtsug nor la jo bos gnang ba'i blo sbyong / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
